story: Mira books travel for Alex Rivera over several weeks; preference flip vegetarian→omnivore; refundable-only decision.

episodes.name: intro-alex
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Hi Mira, I'm Alex Rivera. I live in Seattle and need help planning trips for work and vacations.

episodes.name: employer
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: I work at Cascadia Labs as a staff engineer. My manager is Priya Shah.

episodes.name: seat-pref
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: On flights I always prefer an aisle seat. Window seats make me anxious.

episodes.name: diet-veg
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Please mark me as vegetarian for all airline meals and hotel breakfasts.

episodes.name: loyalty
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: I am a United Airlines MileagePlus gold member. Prefer United when fares are within $80 of the cheapest option.

episodes.name: denver-trip
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Book a round-trip Seattle to Denver for July 20–23 for the Cascadia Labs offsite. Hotel near downtown.

episodes.name: refundable-policy
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Going forward, book only refundable fares for work trips. Non-refundable is fine for personal leisure.

episodes.name: commitment-confirm
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: I commit to sending expense receipts within 48 hours after each work trip.

episodes.name: partner
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: My partner Jordan Lee usually joins personal trips. Jordan prefers boutique hotels over big chains.

episodes.name: diet-flip
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Update my meals — I am no longer vegetarian. I eat fish and poultry again; keep beef rare.

episodes.name: tokyo-goal
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Personal goal: visit Tokyo with Jordan in October for 10 days. Soft budget $4,500 total.

episodes.name: instruction-timezone
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: Always propose itineraries in Pacific Time and flag any meeting that starts before 8am PT.

episodes.name: observation-delay
episodes.content: United flight UA482 SEA→DEN on July 20 was delayed 90 minutes due to weather. Alex rebooked the downtown hotel shuttle.

episodes.name: error-card
episodes.content: Alex Rivera: The corporate card ending 4412 was declined once at check-in — use the backup Amex ending 9001 for hotels.
